text:
Ivy: FYI I'm hitting a weird TS build failure when folks use the next-ts-starter with redwood-js types. CI shows `TS2307: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk' or its corresponding type declarations.` locally after fresh npm i + next build.
Marta: hmm that suggests our SDK package entrypoints don't export types in the way TS expects for `moduleResolution: bundler`/SWC. Can you paste the exact error + package.json from the starter?
Ivy: error snippet: ```bash
node_modules/.pnpm/next@13.5.5/node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js: Error: TypeScript error in /workspace/app/pages/api/chat.ts
TS2307: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk' or its corresponding type declarations.
```
Ivy: starter package.json has "@redwood/sdk": "workspace:^" via monorepo, and tsconfig uses `moduleResolution: "bundler"`.
Ken: seems like the SDK's package.json only has "types" pointing at dist/index.d.ts which works for Node TS resolution but Next/SWC bundler expects `exports` mapping with `types` fields. We added `types` in dist but not in exports.
Marta: good catch. quick fix: add exports map for ESM/CJS with an entry for types in SDK package.json. example: ```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
Ivy: patched locally and it fixed the build for me. but we should also add a smoke CI that `pnpm --filter sample-kit... build` to catch regressions.
Ken: agreed. also need to bump SDK roll for the starter to consume the new package.json layout; otherwise editors still show red squiggles.
Marta: there's another parity issue: LangChain adapter's ChatMessage interface changed shape in TS but sample code still uses old fields (`text` vs `content`). that breaks the eval harness type-check and causes runtime mismatch in e2e typed asserts.
Ivy: exact example: adapter used `message.text` but SDK now returns `{ role: 'assistant', content: string }`. test_evals/chat_eval.ts asserts old shape and fails with `TypeError: Cannot read property 'text' of undefined`.
Ken: short-term: update sample adapter and eval harness to the new shape; long-term: add a types-compat layer in SDK that exports legacy types under `@redwood/sdk/legacy-types` to ease migrations.
DevEx Bot: PR #4988 opened by Marta: "sdk: exports.types + samples: update tsconfig and langchain adapter". CI queued.
Ivy: another flaky eval-harness problem: the harness runs `ts-node` directly against sample code which uses SWC transforms; that yields false negatives. propose precompiling samples (next build) and running harness against compiled output. reduces false negatives and speeds up repeated runs.
Marta: good idea. we can add a new workflow `samples-build-and-eval.yml` that builds once and reuses the preview for multiple checks. also add a lightweight type-only job: `pnpm -w -s -C samples tsc --noEmit` to catch TS regressions fast.
Ken: I'll add the type-only CI job and update the sample starter templates to include a `check-types` script. assigning to @Ken. ETA: 2 days.
Ivy: one more: docs need to call out NextJS/SWC resolution caveats and correct env var patterns for server vs public keys (we had a few users accidentally wiring NEXT_PUBLIC_RW_API in server code). small doc PR will help reduce onboarding friction.
OpsBot: Heads up: staging preview for PR #4988 deployed at https://staging-pr-4988.preview.redwood-inference.internal (expires in 24h).
Marta: after CI + smoke, I'll land the samples PR and ping #devex for a quick verify. thanks team. :sparkles:
